name: Benton Ridge RV Park
note: RV park in the hills south of Warsaw, between Truman Lake and Lake of the Ozarks: full-hookup sites $50 a night (two-night minimum on holidays), alongside monthly and annual sites; bath house, laundry, catch-and-release ponds, on-site bar and grill. Open year round, RVs only. Reserve by phone or the emailed form. Formerly Benton Ridge Winery and Campground. RV Life unrated. --Claude

name: Heit's Point Lutheran Camp
note: Lutheran (LCMS) camp and retreat center at the 80 mile marker of Lake of the Ozarks, open to the public by the night: 17 RV and camper sites with full hookups (30/50-amp, water, sewer), fire ring and picnic table, $40 a night; also tent sites, cabins and retreat-center rooms. Book up to a year ahead; summer camp and group retreats share the grounds. RV Life unrated. --Claude

name: Black Silo RV Campground
note: Small RV campground beside the Black Silo Winery east of Trenton (4030 E 10th St): a row of 30/50-amp full-hookup pull-throughs on a gravel lot, $45 a night plus a $4 campground fee. Online booking (Campspot). RV Life $, unrated. --Claude
